data.narrative:
Firma Power is a seed-stage company in the Climate & Energy sector. The comparable universe consists of 1 public company (Linergia, ticker LNZA) and 8 private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. This sector encompasses diverse business models across energy transition infrastructure, materials science, and advanced manufacturing.

The peer-median method was not applicable to this valuation. Despite identifying 8 companies operating within Climate & Energy, none satisfied the minimum threshold of three datapoints when filtered by stage (seed), adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier. Applying an all-sector median would introduce substantial methodological noise given the heterogeneity of comparable business models, revenue stages, and capital intensity across the peer set. Traditional venture-backed method alternatives (revenue multiples, discounted cash flow) require operational data not provided in this dataset.

Given the absence of tight stage-aligned comparables and quantitative operating metrics, this analysis cannot responsibly narrow to a specific valuation range. The appropriate next steps would be to (1) establish revenue or customer acquisition data if available; (2) assess capital intensity and burn profile relative to the broader peer set; (3) evaluate founder and team pedigree against later-stage Climate & Energy outcomes. Without additional data on Firma's revenue, burn rate, or technical differentiation, any point estimate would lack evidentiary support.
